capabilities: Send selected text to a dataset file as a prompt
Send selected text as a completion to the stored prompt
Insert selections as open-ended generation entries with empty prompts
Configure prompt and completion prefixes and suffixes for jsonl output
extras: The README says a feature to export the txt dataset to a jsonl file will be added soon, and asks for help with development; defaults target OpenAI's jsonl fine-tuning format.
motivation: The author was inspired by the efficiency of fine-tuning a language model and wanted to build datasets from notes in the form of prompts and responses.
problem: Creating custom fine-tuning datasets for text generation models by hand is tedious and slow, and Obsidian offers no way to capture note text as training pairs.

relations.evidence: This plugin shares simularities to the textTransporter Plugin made by TfTHacker

summary: Fine-tuning dataset builder that sends note selections to a txt dataset file as prompt/completion pairs formatted for OpenAI-style fine-tuning.
